signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the roadmap for your product area end to end — from customer discovery and validation through launch, iteration, and measurement
Partner with the Head of Product to translate company strategy into a focused, prioritized plan for your area, and represent that plan to the leadership team
Partner closely with engineering as a true thought partner: drive execution, work through trade-offs, and ship on fast cycles
Stay close to our customers to deeply understand their workflows and the decisions our platform needs to power
Lead and grow a small team of PMs: hire, mentor, and manage while staying hands-on in the work yourself
